theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: The detector's one-narrative structure concentrates leadership in Banks, which is the only theme with simultaneously high score, high durability_bar (0.74), trend hurst, and broad participation (breadth 0.833). This is a focus lens, not an alpha signal, and crowding_z 1.72 is a sizing caution only. Given gate_helps is false on this market's history, the lean is expressed as a conditional: IF Banks maintain breadth above ~0.8 and durability_bar above ~0.7, THEN the trend-following structure favors staying exposed. Track record dir_accuracy is 0.366, so conviction is held low.
theses.dissent: The crowding_z of 1.72 alongside low absorption (0.37) indicates the move is reflexively self-reinforcing; on a mean-reverting tape (gate_helps false), a crowded leader can unwind faster than the trend gate can react, and the one validated edge (drawdown avoidance) does not hold on this market.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS underperforms the CSI 300 benchmark by more than 5% over any 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is eligible but mixed hurst (not trend), breadth is only 0.5, and it is crowded-true (crowding_z 1.38). The crowding flag is a sizing caution, but combined with mixed trend health and only mid-level durability_bar 0.57, the theme lacks the structural cohesion of the leader. Under a one-narrative regime with gate_helps false, non-leader eligible themes carry whipsaw risk without trend confirmation.
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO has a distinct macro catalyst path (innovation policy, CXO order flows) that the momentum rank will not capture, and its crowding could reflect genuine positioning ahead of a catalyst; the detector's mean-reverting history means a crowded eligible theme could revert upward just as easily as continue lower.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO ETF 159992.SZ closes above its 20-day high with breadth above 0.7 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the ranked challenger in rotation (score 0.51) but is ineligible (eligibility false), has durability_bar 0.2, mixed hurst, and breadth of only 0.1. The rotation radar shows a narrow two-eligible-name structure with a 0.143 margin — no confirmed handoff. In a one-narrative regime, the challenger lacks the trend and breadth needed to justify directional exposure, and the detector explicitly warns against predicting the next narrative.
theses.dissent: Coal can move on idiosyncratic supply shocks or energy policy unrelated to its detected trend health, and its rank-2 challenger status is closer than any other theme to the leader; if a confirmed handoff materializes, this read would change.

falsifier.text: Coal closes the score gap to Banks to under 0.05 AND Coal's breadth rises above 0.5 before the check-by date
